title: Review before consequential submission
summary: Give users a structured opportunity to review and edit important information immediately before a consequential submission.
problem: Users can complete a long transaction without noticing incorrect or outdated answers until after irreversible submission.
use_when: Submitting creates a meaningful transaction, application, purchase, or account change
Errors would be costly or difficult to reverse
avoid_when: The action is low-risk, instantly reversible, and review would add friction without meaningful benefit
rationale: Review increases confidence and provides a final correction point.
Change paths should return users to review instead of replaying the whole flow.

use_if: Submitting creates a meaningful transaction, application, purchase, or account change
Errors would be costly or difficult to reverse
prefer_alternatives_if: The action is safely reversible and already offers immediate undo

requirements: Give repeated change actions contextual accessible names.
Keep reading order and section hierarchy clear.
Preserve focus and context when returning from edits.
Summarize relevant answers in understandable groups.
Make the final action label describe the consequence.
